name: Centro Historico
description: Puebla's UNESCO-listed historic center, a grid of talavera-tiled facades, baroque churches and the grand Zocalo. Packed with cafes, museums, restaurants and colonial hotels, it is the most walkable and culturally rich base in the city.
bestFor: Nomads wanting walkable colonial beauty, cafes, culture and central location

name: Cholula
tagline: Ancient pyramid town with student energy
description: A lively neighboring town famed for its great pyramid topped by a church, plus a young university crowd. Cholula mixes cobbled streets, craft breweries, cafes and a relaxed bohemian feel, making it a favorite for longer-stay nomads near Puebla.
bestFor: Nomads wanting a laid-back student town with cafes, nightlife and pyramid views

name: La Paz
description: An established leafy residential zone west of the center with tree-lined avenues, mid-range and upscale housing, restaurants and easy access to Angelopolis malls. Quiet and comfortable, it appeals to visitors wanting a calm base with good amenities.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting a quiet leafy area with restaurants and easy mall access

name: Angelopolis
description: Puebla's modern district of glass high-rises, large shopping malls, corporate offices and new apartment towers. It offers the city's most contemporary living with gyms, cinemas and reliable services, favored by those preferring new builds over colonial charm.
bestFor: Nomads wanting modern apartments, malls, gyms and reliable infrastructure
